top_5_v5_archs.name: v5_diff_attn
top_5_v5_archs.paper: Differential Transformer, Ye et al., Microsoft/Tsinghua, arxiv 2410.05258, Oct 2024
top_5_v5_archs.description: Replace cross-sym MHSA with Differential Attention. Two softmax maps subtract → noise cancellation. Lambda is learnable per-head. Directly addresses noisy 5×5 attention weights in financial cross-sym interaction.
top_5_v5_archs.key_change: Split Q,K into halves; compute (A1 - λ·A2)@V with per-head RMSNorm
top_5_v5_archs.training_notes: lambda parameters learned via gradient; RMSNorm per head important for stability

top_5_v5_archs.name: v5_mask_ssl
top_5_v5_archs.paper: VIME: Value Imputation and Mask Estimation, Yoon et al., NeurIPS 2020, arxiv 2003.08013
top_5_v5_archs.description: Add mask estimation pretext task. Random 30% feature corruption → encoder must predict binary mask (which features corrupted). Forces encoder to learn feature co-occurrence patterns, complementary to reconstruction.
top_5_v5_archs.key_change: Add MaskHead (d_latent→n_feat binary) + VIME corruption in forward(); loss += mask_alpha * BCE(mask_pred, mask)
top_5_v5_archs.training_notes: total_loss += recon_alpha*recon_loss + mask_alpha*bce_loss; log all three

top_5_v5_archs.name: v5_glu_v_attn
top_5_v5_archs.paper: GLU Attention Improve Transformer, Wang, arxiv 2507.00022, Jul 2025
top_5_v5_archs.description: GLU-gate the values in cross-sym attention. V_proj outputs 2×d_latent, split and gate: V_out = SiLU(V1)*V2. Forces selective activation of sym-information, compatible with existing attention structure.
top_5_v5_archs.key_change: v_proj: d→2d; v_gated = silu(v[:d])*v[d:]; rest unchanged
top_5_v5_archs.training_notes: Same training setup as sae_cross_sym baseline

top_5_v5_archs.name: v5_market_adaln
top_5_v5_archs.paper: MASTER (AAAI 2024) market-guided feature selection + DiT AdaLN-Zero (Peebles 2023)
top_5_v5_archs.description: After cross-sym attention, compute market context = mean(z_attn, dim=sym). Use AdaLN to derive scale/shift for each sym's latent from market context. Market state modulates per-sym feature importance dynamically.
top_5_v5_archs.training_notes: AdaLN-Zero init critical: zero-init adaln_proj weights/bias for stable training start

top_5_v5_archs.name: v5_diff_swiglu
top_5_v5_archs.description: Kitchen-sink combo: Differential Attention in cross-sym layer + SwiGLU FFN in encoder and pred head. If diff_attn alone works well, this adds SwiGLU's gating benefit on top.
top_5_v5_archs.key_change: Diff-Attn + SwiGLU encoder [n_feat→2d_hidden→d_latent] + SwiGLU pred head
top_5_v5_archs.training_notes: Run after v5_diff_attn confirms promise; if diff_attn fails, don't bother

rejected_archs.name: HATS (graph)
rejected_archs.reason: requires static stock adjacency matrix, not sym-agnostic

key_insight: sae_cross_sym already validated cross-sym attention works (+4.91 vs sae_mlp). The bottleneck is QUALITY of the 5×5 attention (noise in financial signals) + QUALITY of encoder regularization (reconstruction only). Differential Attention cancels attention noise directly; VIME mask estimation forces feature correlation learning. These two orthogonal improvements should be prioritized and combined.
